title: Ensure 'Configure multicast DNS (mDNS) protocol' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\DNS Client\Configure multicast DNS (mDNS) protocol to 'Disabled'
reason: A threat actor can listen on a network over UDP port 5353 and respond to them, tricking the host into thinking that it knows the location of the requested system.

title: Ensure 'Configure NetBIOS settings' is set to 'Enabled: Disable NetBIOS name resolution on public networks'
powershell_check: try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient' -Name 'EnableNetbios' -ErrorAction Stop).EnableNetbios; if ($v -eq 0 -or $v -eq 2) { 1 } else { 0 } } catch { 0 }
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\DNS Client\Configure NetBIOS settings to 'Enabled: Disable NetBIOS name resolution on public networks'
reason: NetBIOS does not perform authentication and can allow remote threat actors to cause a denial-of-service by sending spoofed Name Conflicts or Name Release datagrams.

title: Ensure 'Turn off default IPv6 DNS Servers' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\DNS Client\Turn off default IPv6 DNS Servers to 'Enabled'
reason: Disabling the use of IPv6 DNS server addresses removes a possible attack surface that is also harder to monitor the traffic on.

title: Ensure 'Turn off multicast name resolution' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\DNS Client\Turn off multicast name resolution to 'Enabled'
reason: A threat actors can listen on a network for these LLMNR (UDP/5355) or NBT-NS (UDP/137) broadcasts and respond to them.
